title: Variational, which offers blockchain-based derivatives tied to cryptocurrencies and traditional assets, raised a $110M Series B at a $1.5B valuation (Jason Shubnell/The Block)
summary: Jason Shubnell / The Block: Variational, which offers blockchain-based derivatives tied to cryptocurrencies and traditional assets, raised a $110M Series B at a $1.5B valuation — Traditional markets account for more than half of daily trading volume on its Omni trading platform.
